verdict.rationale: Expensify's own docs say users can ask its AI for instant answers and charts about their account data, up to quarterly flux analysis, so in-product insights are directly documented. The suggestions half is thinner: it rests on behavior-based auto-categorization and asking the AI to fix setup mistakes, and a hands-on user report says categorization is often wrong, which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: documented proactive AI suggestions or recommendations surfaced from user data, independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI insights/charts feature, and depth on what insights are generated beyond vendor blog claims.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Get instant answers and charts for anything in your account, from monthly spend to a full quarterly flux analysis
Expensify uses your policies and past behavior to auto-categorize expenses as they're created.
fix your own setup mistakes by just asking
